mapper.select: select c.campaign_key as campaignKey, c.target_type as targetType, c.target_id as targetId, case c.target_type when 1 then t.name when 2 then a.name else null end as targetTitle, c.status as status, c.issued_at as issuedAt, c.expires_at as expiresAt from marketing_referral_credential c left join cms_topic t on c.target_type = 1 and t.id = c.target_id left join cms_activity a on c.target_type = 2 and a.id = c.target_id where c.sharer_member_id = #{memberId} order by c.issued_at desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}

select a.campaign_key as campaignKey, c.target_type as targetType, c.target_id as targetId, case c.target_type when 1 then t.name when 2 then act.name else null end as targetTitle, count(*) as attributedOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paidOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paidAmount, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as refundedOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as refundedAmount, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and ra.id is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as heldOrders from marketing_attribution a join marketing_referral_credential c on c.id = a.credential_id and c.sharer_member_id = #{memberId} left join cms_topic t on c.target_type = 1 and t.id = c.target_id left join cms_activity act on c.target_type = 2 and act.id = c.target_id left join cms_registration r on r.id = a.order_id and a.order_type = 1 left join marketing_revenue_allocation ra on ra.order_type = a.order_type and ra.order_id = a.order_id where a.sharer_member_id = #{memberId} group by a.campaign_key, c.target_type, c.target_id, t.name, act.name order by paidOrders desc, attributedOrders desc limit #{limit}

select a.status as allocationStatus, a.currency as currency, l.entry_type as entryType, count(distinct a.id) as allocationCount, coalesce(sum(l.amount_fen), 0) as amountFen from marketing_revenue_allocation_line l join marketing_revenue_allocation a on a.id = l.allocation_id where l.recipient_member_id = #{memberId} and l.line_role = 'referrer' group by a.status, a.currency, l.entry_type
